C.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction, equivalent fractions, simplification)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (and whole numbers when needed) into equivalent improper fractions with a specified denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction n = (n·d)/d to match a denominator
exclusion_criteria: Only finding an LCM/common denominator without converting a mixed/whole number
Only reducing/simplifying a fraction after computation

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and express each fraction as an equivalent fraction over that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds an LCM or chooses a common denominator for unlike denominators
A step scales numerators/denominators to create equivalent fractions with the common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already the same and no conversion is needed
Only converting mixed numbers to improper fractions without addressing unlike denominators

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two rational numbers once they are in compatible forms (same denominator or separated whole/fraction parts).
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a common denominator
A step subtracts whole parts and fractional parts and combines the result
exclusion_criteria: Only converting forms (mixed↔improper) without performing subtraction
Only simplifying/reducing the final fraction

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms and/or express an improper fraction as a mixed number or integer when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number or identifies a whole-number result (e.g., 0, 1)
exclusion_criteria: Only performing subtraction without any reduction or re-expression
Only finding a common denominator or converting mixed numbers prior to subtraction

B.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction, equivalent fractions, simplification)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (including nonstandard ones like 1 4/3) into equivalent improper fractions or equivalent fractional forms suitable for computation.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a nonstandard mixed number (e.g., 2 3/2) as a sum a + b/c and then as a single fraction
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction with a specified denominator (e.g., 3 = 15/5)
exclusion_criteria: Only finding an LCM/common denominator without converting mixed/whole numbers
Only reducing/simplifying a fraction after subtraction
Only subtracting numerators once denominators already match

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine and use a common denominator (often via LCM) to rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions with the same denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly computes lcm(denominator1, denominator2)
A step scales numerator/denominator to create equivalent fractions with a shared denominator (e.g., 5/3 = 20/12)
A step chooses a convenient common denominator (e.g., 24) and converts both fractions to that denominator
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already equal and the step proceeds directly to subtract numerators
Only converting mixed numbers to improper fractions without addressing differing denominators
Only simplifying/reducing after the subtraction is done

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two rational numbers once they are expressed with compatible denominators or decomposed into whole and fractional parts.
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a common denominator (e.g., 20/12 − 9/12)
A step subtracts whole parts and fractional parts separately and combines the result
A step handles zero results from subtracting equal quantities (e.g., 2/3 − 2/3 = 0)
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator or converting forms without performing the subtraction
Only reducing/simplifying the final fraction
Only rewriting the final answer as a mixed number without doing the subtraction

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms and/or express an improper fraction as an equivalent mixed number or integer when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor (e.g., 21/12 = 7/4)
A step states a fraction is already in lowest terms
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number (e.g., 6/5 = 1 1/5) or to an integer (e.g., 3/3 = 1)
exclusion_criteria: Only performing the subtraction without any reduction or formatting
Only finding common denominators or converting mixed numbers prior to subtraction
Changing denominators to subtract (that is S02), not to reduce
